$birth=[Scotty20261125TrayJobInspector]::Birth($Process.Handle,$entry.process_id)
    $registered=@($JobOwned|Where-Object{$_.process_id -eq $entry.process_id -and $_.birth_filetime -eq $birth})

Require fresh output, stdout, stderr, receipt and task; the expected logged-in user with Explorer session 1; free port 43972; and 3 GiB available physical memory twice. Use Schedule.Service COM create-only flag 2 and RunEx session flag 4 for one Limited hidden BelowNormal task. Its sole PowerShell host calls the reviewed helper in the same process, preserves its exit code and redirects both PowerShell output streams to new sibling logs, including pre-output failures. Retain this task, receipt and logs for exact result reconciliation and later owned cleanup; never replay this command after registration or an uncertain outcome.
